You have the one who brings into rhythm in piety through evangelical decrees. Those who call upon idols under thick trees, slaughtering their children in the clefts among the rocks. That is your portion, this is your lot, and to them you poured out libations, and to them you offered sacrifices. On these things, therefore, I will not be angry? On a high and lofty mountain, there is your bed, and there you brought up sacrifices, and behind the doorposts of your door you set your reminder. Having called them murderers, it shows that hatred of God was a weakness in them, and the readiness for bloodshed was not new in them, but rather it was inherent in them from long ago. For you are those who call upon idols under thick trees, according to the times above. Although the law through Moses was being given to them, saying, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and serve him only,' they fell into madness, or rather, into impiety beyond all measure, so as to become makers of idols, and to minister to them, and to call upon them, or to teach others to worship under thick trees, and to crown them with divine honors. This is clearly established by the God of all things through the voice of Jeremiah, saying, 'You saw what the house of Israel did to me…'

They went upon every high mountain and under every leafy tree and fornicated there, seizing the mountain tops and the most beautiful parts of the groves, building altars and temples, offering sacrifices and libations to the unclean demons; there are also those who spared not their own children; Jehonias slaughtered his own son to the non-existent gods; God said through one of the holy prophets, showing the savagery of those who do such things, 'Sacrifice humans, for calves are lacking'; you are the ones calling upon idols, slaughtering your children under dense trees in the ravines among the rocks; what then is your portion? Your lot is that you have bowed down to vain things and will have a vain portion and lot; that is, you will be bound by equal evils and slaughter will be your portion and lot; because you became a child-killer and poured libations to unclean and lifeless demon idols, offering sacrifices to them
pass_b_english: Those who call upon idols under thick trees are the ones who slaughter their children in the clefts among the rocks.
By calling them murderers, God shows that hatred of Him was a deep-seated weakness in them and that their readiness for bloodshed was not a new development, but rather a long-standing inherent trait.
You are the ones who, according to the times above, call upon idols under thick trees.

Although the law through Moses was given to them, saying, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and serve Him only' (Deuteronomy 6:13), they fell into madness, or rather, into impiety beyond all measure, as they became makers of idols and ministers to them.
They even taught others to worship under thick trees, crowning these idols with divine honors, which is a clear violation of God's commandments.

This is clearly established by God through the voice of Jeremiah, who said, 'You saw what the house of Israel did to me' (Jeremiah 3:6), describing how they went upon every high mountain and under every leafy tree and fornicated there.
They seized the mountain tops and the most beautiful parts of the groves, building altars and temples, and offering sacrifices and libations to the unclean demons.
Some even spared not their own children, as Jehonias slaughtered his own son to the non-existent gods.
God said through one of the holy prophets, 'Sacrifice humans, for calves are lacking' (Jeremiah 7:31).
You are the ones calling upon idols, slaughtering your children under dense trees in the ravines among the rocks.
On these things, therefore, shall I not be angry?
Your lot is that you have bowed down to vain things and will have a vain portion and lot.
You will be bound by equal evils and slaughter will be your portion and lot, because you became a child-killer and poured libations to unclean and lifeless demon idols, offering sacrifices to them.
